headline_stat.name: POST vs PRE significant-replay two-proportion z

justification.dataset: 000044 Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1 (Achilles linear-track session) is the canonical hippocampal-replay dataset, an expert's choice.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, correct epochs/states, excitatory-cell and speed filtering, and direction-specific place fields, all explicit and defensible.
justification.analysis: Bayesian decoder validated on running (r=0.96) then applied in 20 ms bins with weighted correlation and a proper per-event position-shuffle null; only weakness is a direction-combined decoding template.
justification.correctness: All reported numbers (5 cm error, r=0.96, 14%/21%, z=6.6, ~12 m/s) reproduce from the printed code and are internally consistent with the figures and each other.
justification.figures: Every panel is labeled with units and sample sizes, the effect is clearly visible, and the example events are ranked by weighted correlation (the effect itself), not an unrelated criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and nothing is misrepresented, but there is no limitations section and the elevated PRE-sleep significance (a hint the per-event test may be anticonservative) is reported without caveat, holding this to 3.
justification.verdict: A clean, well-controlled, reproducible end-to-end replay demonstration on the right dataset; you would take the result and move on.
